frontmatter.title: Scraping the Mexican Senate
frontmatter.description: Using Julia to scrape useful information from the Mexican Senate's website.

frontmatter.title: Voting patterns in the Mexican Senate
frontmatter.description: A network representation of the voting patterns of the Mexican Senate in the LXII and LXIII legislatures between 2012 and 2017.

frontmatter.title: Bot Emmett Brown
frontmatter.description: A Twitter bot that generates text according to the Doc's dialogues in the 3 Back to the Future movies.

frontmatter.title: Mexican Senate Coalitions
frontmatter.description: Coalitions in the Mexican Senate from a complex networks point of view.

frontmatter.title: Fractals from random walkers
frontmatter.description: Using L-systems and Diffusion-Limited Aggregation to create fractals.

frontmatter.title: A Cellular Automata Sznajd Model
frontmatter.description: Using a Sznajd model to simulate opinion dynamics in a 2D lattice and the effect of bots.

frontmatter.title: Analysis of a Temporal Asylum Seekers Network
frontmatter.description: Using temporal networks to analyze asylum seekers petitions between countries from 2000 to 2017.

frontmatter.title: 19S - Mexico's Resilience in an Earthquake Event
frontmatter.description: A study of Mexico City's resilience after the September 19, 2017 earthquake using mobility and social media data.

frontmatter.title: Listening to Communities During the Ebola Crisis
frontmatter.description: How unmet needs shaped behaviors during the 2014-2015 Ebola outbreak in Sierra Leone.

frontmatter.title: Socioeconomic Disparities in Mobility During COVID-19
frontmatter.description: How mobility changes during the COVID-19 pandemic varied widely by socioeconomic status in six developing countries.

frontmatter.title: WorkReach: How Distance, Job Quality, and Informality Shape Where We Work
frontmatter.description: Understanding urban work location choices through a new discrete-choice model blending distance, economic complexity, and informality.
